Useful as a health check before relying on results in production workflows." → after: "Run the full regression suite: 60 canonical test vectors (linear and inverse/coin-margined) across all 12 calculators, and return a pass/fail report with counts and timestamp. Useful as a health check before relying on results in production workflows."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
